summary: Selected startups with 20 or fewer employees can receive $10,000 in Voice Agent Platform credits for up to six months. Teams worldwide may apply; voice must be a core product capability, not a secondary feature. The program prioritizes leading-accelerator teams, early-stage venture-backed companies and exceptional bootstrapped founders.
claim_steps: Confirm the startup has 20 or fewer employees and voice is a core product capability; worldwide teams and exceptional bootstrapped founders may apply.
Create a Smallest.ai account if needed.
Submit the grant application with company, product, team, and voice-AI usage details.
If selected, credits are applied to the account email supplied in the application.

social_proof.title: Startup Grants Program for Voice AI - Smallest.ai
social_proof.text: Selected startups get $10,000 in credits to build with our Voice Agent Platform for up to 6 months. Startups should have 20 or fewer employees and be open to teams worldwide.

social_proof.title: Apply: Voice AI Startup Grants - Smallest.ai
social_proof.text: Enter the email ID associated with your smallest.ai account where you would like the grant credits to be applied if selected.
